name: Cupid
status: Available to license. {licence}, self-hosted or hosted.
lede: A web management system for matchmaking and dating agencies — a cloud-ready rewrite of the classic Cuore desktop application.
about: A web management system for matchmaking and dating agencies.
description: Cupid is a web management system for matchmaking and dating agencies: client records, partner requests, affinity matching, meetings, contracts, printing, GDPR tooling and encrypted backups.
summary: A cloud-ready rewrite of the classic Cuore desktop application, delivered as a single container an agency can run itself.

stack.label: Backend
stack.value: Go 1.25 (chi router), SQLite (modernc.org/sqlite, pure-Go), goose migrations

stack.label: Frontend
stack.value: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript + Mantine, i18n (Italian by default)

stack.label: API
stack.value: OpenAPI 3 contract with generated server (Go) and client (TS) types

stack.label: Security
stack.value: Ed25519-signed license keys (offline verification), CSP + HSTS, login rate limiting, argon2id

stack.label: Delivery
stack.value: A single distroless Docker image with the SPA embedded and a /data volume
